Brackenridge Health
Mr Imran Shah
Hospital number: BH-517302
Date: 5 October 2026
Your procedure: appointment and preparation
Dear Mr Imran Shah,
You are booked for a colonoscopy. A thin, flexible tube with a camera is used to look at the lining of your large
bowel. This letter tells you when and where to come, how to prepare, and what to expect afterwards. Please read it
carefully and keep it.
Your appointment
Date Wednesday 4 November 2026
Please arrive at 13:00

Where Endoscopy Unit, Ground Floor, Brackenridge General Hospital
Anaesthetic Sedation (you will be relaxed and drowsy but not fully asleep)
Type of stay Day case: expect to be with us for about 4 hours
Eating and drinking
Follow a low-fibre diet for 2 days before your appointment. Have your last solid food by 9am on Tuesday 3
November 2026. After that, take the bowel preparation as described on the separate sheet and drink clear fluids

only. You can keep drinking clear fluids (water, squash, black tea) until 11am on the day of your appointment.
Your medicines
(cid:127) Stop taking iron tablets 7 days before your appointment.
(cid:127) If you take blood-thinning medicines or medicines for diabetes, call the pre-assessment team. Do not stop them
without advice.
What to bring
(cid:127) A list of your medicines
(cid:127) A dressing gown and slippers
(cid:127) Your bowel preparation instruction sheet

Please leave jewellery and valuables at home.
Going home
You must arrange for a responsible adult to take you home and stay with you for 24 hours. Do not drive, cycle or
operate machinery for 24 hours after sedation.
You may feel bloated for a few hours. Most people are back to normal the next day.
When to get help
Contact us straight away if you have any of the following:
(cid:127) Severe tummy pain
(cid:127) Passing more than a small amount of blood
(cid:127) A high temperature
